text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While passing by the kitchen――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, perfect timing! We're about 
to make nutritional food in class. Come 
watch!!
choice_data_list: Huh! But won't I be in the way?

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I don't mind as long as you're only 
observing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone at their stations? Set 
sail!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It seems my "friend"... is full of 
motivation too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's get this over with quickly.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Take care of me, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, what they're making is an oat 
milk quiche aimed at strengthening bones.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Strengthening bones, is it? I just so 
happen to have a drug... I mean, a secret 
ingredient I've been wanting to test.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean—hyah...!? W-Wait, the 
cooking utensils are floating...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... We're not using this equipment, 
so... That one isn't ready either...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Awawa...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Being too free-spirited is trouble 
in itself! At this rate, the ship's gonna 
fall apart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Does it matter if the "secret 
ingredient" isn't so secret...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking one portion of seasoning. 
Before you go throwing weird stuff in it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't be like that! Making it together is 
the best part!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe "agrees."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, totally!! Hey, Universe, tell 
this lone wolf a thing or two more!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Calculation" complete. Following the 
recipe to the letter is just "noise" to 
Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To "tune the sound," you need 5g of a 
secret ingredient. A small amount won't 
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that? Shakur, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. I'll do the measuring. Hand over 
the secret ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, let's just be glad it's 
usable.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll leave prepping the 
seasonings to the three of you! Thanks, 
guys!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's up? Why are you freezing up! I was 
counting on your fiery spirit!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! I-I'm just about to start! Hey, 
someone hand me a cutting board already!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slip...!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: C-C-Ch-Che— Ow!! GYAAAAAAHHH!?!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my "friend"... wants to cook 
with everyone too...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, have your "friend" 
help out too~! It's great that it's 
nutritious, but there are so many 
ingredients! Chopping them all is tough!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...My 'friend' is all fired up. I'll... do 
my best too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm gonna do it too...! ...Can't keep 
looking like a total loser...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Our group came together...! 
Tap-chan, I'll do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, great! Thanks! All crew on deck, 
full speed ahead from here!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—And lastly, plate it up... All right, 
dinner is complete!!
choice_data_list:
Everyone worked together efficiently to 
make this!

Everyone made this so quickly and 
efficiently, huh!

You did a great job patiently assigning 
all the tasks.

You did a great job patiently assigning 
all the tasks, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—And lastly, plate it up... All right, 
dinner is complete!!
choice_data_list:
Everyone worked together efficiently to 
make this!

Everyone made this so quickly and 
efficiently, huh!

You did a great job patiently assigning 
all the tasks.

You did a great job patiently assigning 
all the tasks, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
They're all exceptional folks, after all! 
As long as we set the same course, it'll 
be over in no time!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was so much fun and so 
reassuring...! I'm so glad I was in the 
same group as everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, let the feast begin! This banquet 
prepared by the entire crew!!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food! Thanks for the 
food... Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the crew together is part of the 
captain's job too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like our group finished first. Even 
if it's practical training, I ain't giving 
up the title of strongest!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Doppler." Cooking with everyone was 
"fun."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we're on the same boat, we gotta 
link arms! That's what sailing is all 
about!
